competing_explanation: The policy may have changed, the window may be measured from purchase rather than delivery, or standard items may be subject to exceptions or restocking conditions.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, typically measured from delivery or receipt.
refutation_criterion: Evidence shows the current full-refund window for standard items is not 30 days, or that full refunds are unavailable for standard items under current policy.
